note: ORPHAN Pro 30:26 — the rock badgers are a people not mighty, yet they make their homes in the cliffs.

dims.v: provident wisdom — the feeble badger securing its home in the rock

the rock badgers who, though not mighty, make their homes in the cliffs — the provident wisdom of the weak that compensates for want of strength by shrewd security, finding in the rock a refuge no strength could win
the shrewd wisdom that, lacking strength, secures itself in the safety of the rock

atsum (mighty), negated — 'the rock badgers are a people not MIGHTY, yet they make their homes in the cliffs' (30:26); one of the four small-but-wise creatures (30:24). The feeble badger's wisdom is to build where no strength can reach it. Prudence compensates for weakness by choosing a sure refuge (cf 30:25).
